title: pi-dynamic-workflows contract runs biome `check` before build/test — lint failure masks real test status
detail: In the contract lane, pi-dynamic-workflows runs `bun run check` (biome) BEFORE build + bun test:unit. A lint failure (e.g. 45 errors / 3 warnings) exits the stage with code 1 and build/test never execute, so contract.overallOk=false with no signal on whether the actual tests pass. When pdw fails the contract lane, always re-run `bun run build && bun test` locally to distinguish lint drift from a real test regression before diagnosing. Sample recurring fixable: tests/workflow.test.ts organizeImports import sort order (FIXABLE).

title: build lane (build:all + verify e2e) is stable and green across runs
detail: The build lane consistently produces a working pi-agent bundle + standalone binary and passes the verify e2e gate. Observed 2026-07-04: buildAllOk=true, verifyOk=true. Artifacts: dist/pi-agent/pi-agent.js (6.8 MB) + pi-agent.js.map; symlink node_modules → pi deps store; standalone binary dist/pi-agent/pi-agent (70.2 MB); copied assets (theme/, export-html/, assets/). Modes: bundle+minify + standalone binary compile. verify (e2e-extensions.test.ts): 1 pass, 25 skip, 0 fail, 5 expect() calls (3.20s), no extension-load errors. Treat build-lane failures as environmental/sandbox, not code regressions, unless reproducible.

title: Bun package contract test-count baselines (2026-07-04)
detail: Contract lane per-package pass counts for regression detection — a sudden drop signals a real regression or a skipped-file leak. pi-agent: 670 pass / 39 skip / 0 fail (1449 expect(), 36 files, 10.37s). pi-agent-cli: 179 pass / 0 fail (292 expect(), 9 files, 277ms). pi-vlm: 110 pass / 0 fail (282 expect(), 11 files, 265ms). pi-obsidian: 337 pass / 0 fail (746 expect(), 42 files, 509ms) — includes 60 passed baseline-contract + search benchmark (18 notes: cold=0.9ms warm=0.5ms). pi-dynamic-workflows: UNKNOWN — biome check failed before tests ran (see pdw-contract:biome-check-gates-build-test).
